    How to fly

    Flying

    S WPull the nose up / push it down
    A DRoll left / right. On the ground, steer
    Q ERudder left / right
    SpaceThrottle up (hold)
    ShiftThrottle down (hold)
    BWheel brakes (hold)
    CChange camera. Drag the mouse to look around
    TabWorld map
    EnterPause

    Taking off

    Battery M, engine I, flaps 1 F, parking brake off P. Hold Space for full throttle, then pull back gently with S once the airspeed needle reaches the green arc.

    Advanced cockpit

    Switch Cockpit: Advanced on in the main menu or the pause menu. Every plane starts cold and dark, and you run the real start-up from the switches: batteries, generators, APU, fuel pumps, magnetos or engine masters. Click a switch to flip it, right-click to move it back, scroll on knobs and levers. Drag or use the arrow keys to look around, double-click to recentre. Press U for the guide: it lists each step of the flight and points at the next switch.

    Cockpit switches

    MBattery master
    IEngine start / stop
    GLanding gear
    F RFlaps down / up one notch
    TSpoilers (air brakes)
    PParking brake
    L N KLanding, nav and strobe lights
    HAutopilot: hold heading and altitude
    JSmoke trail
    XDrop cargo or water; release the selected weapon
    VFire the cannon (hold). Military jets only
    ZSwitch weapon: rockets, missiles, bombs

    Emergencies and weather

    Any mission can bring an engine failure, a fire, or jammed gear (1 in 10), and separately a thunderstorm, extreme wind or fog (1 in 10). In an emergency, land at the nearest airport or on any flat field and stop. Press I to cut a burning engine. With jammed gear, touch down gently on the belly.

    Landing

    Slow down with Shift, gear down G, flaps 2 or 3 F. Touch down gently on the runway, then hold B to stop.
